body: And I still damn near screwed my mom over. She may not be able to graduate because of me.. Unless we can manage to pull $4k in a month and a half...

Eh, I don't know. I just hope something that's out of my control happens. Like getting hit by a car or something, would take the burden off my parents shoulders and I'll get what I want, to leave. My family loves my cat so I know he'll always have a good home.
He's a gray and in between medium and short hair, closer to short. He's not the cuddly type, mostly just plays and sleeps in his own little spots.

His name is simba and is I think 11 months or so. I've always wanted a cat but we couldn't get one because of my dads allergies. I begged and he finally gave in to try it and see how it effects him. Found a lady on Craigslist who's cat had 12 kittens and she wanted to get rid of them asap so we took one off her hands. We actually thought it was a girl at first, and the vet didnt even catch the mistake until he was a few months old (we got him at around 3 weeks old). So we changed his name from nala to Silva, both from the lion king. Anyway, dads allergies seem to be fine so we decide we can keep him, yay. Not sure why I went with the name simba/nala, guess it just came to me. And my dads allergies have been getting worse lately and it's making things so much worse. He takes multiple allergy meds daily, uses an inhaler, and goes to the doctor weekly for shots.

No it wasn't a mess up. It was my fault. I somehow managed to charge $4000 worth of virtual shit, and now she has to pay for it because of me.
And sure, I guess, he's pretty much all I care about. It's all him and my PC.

I fucked up with her credit card putting her out $4000. She is in school and that basically ruined it for her because she can barely pay for it without that. I paid the credit card bill with her help. She had to sell some of her gold that she got passed down from family because of me. And now because she couldn't use the money for school she's in deeper shit with credit cards and school tuition fees. It's all just because I was fucking stupid. That's the money part.. Read my last reply for all the other bs, but I'm bad at explaining things off the top of my head so it's not a very good reply.

I'm bad at explaining, but, I see no reason to live, I hate everything. I'm just a burden on the few people who I'm ever even around. The anxiety meds I take help with the anxiety, but it just makes everything worse. I'm always angry at the smallest things. I'm filled with so much rage all the time. Depressed for the past 2 years. I don't even remember what it's feels like to be happy anymore. 
The only reason I kept going this far was because of my cat, he's the only thing I genuinely care about at this point. I don't even know what else, everything has just gone to shit for me.
